subject: Trading
title: Gap Risk and Stops
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Gap Risk and Stops.

hook.text: Your stop is at $95. The stock closes at $98. It opens the next morning at $85. Your stop never triggered at $95.

buildup.text: Gaps happen when the market opens at a very different price from the previous close—skipping your stop level.

discovery.text: After-hours earnings, geopolitical events, or analyst downgrades can cause gaps that make stops useless.

twist.text: Stop-losses don't guarantee your exit price. In gaps, you get the first available price—which can be much worse.

climax.text: To protect against gaps: reduce position size before earnings, diversify across positions, or hedge with options.

punchline.text: Stops work in theory. Gaps test them in reality.

quiz.question: What is gap risk?
options: The risk of missing a trade
Price opening far from the prior close, skipping your stop-loss level
